artifact_policy.availability_gate: Missing, expired, corrupt or unbound artifacts cannot certify delivery; restore from the pinned Git object or rerun the affected check before crediting it.
artifact_policy.large_logs: Retain complete REPO_SAFE diagnostic and proof log blobs in the repository Git object store. Git stores these repeated textual outputs compressed internally; no verifier output is trimmed or normalized.
artifact_policy.location: verification/agones/runs under the verified PR/delivery commit; immutable manifests bind every full log with SHA-256.
artifact_policy.provider: Content-addressed Git object store in QuasarRay/agones
artifact_policy.retention: Keep referenced evidence commits reachable through the review branch and eventual agones-rs-dev history until their claims are explicitly superseded. Never prune the only retained artifact behind a live claim.
artifact_policy.retrieval: Fetch the delivery commit recorded in the ledger/PR receipt, then git show <verified-commit>:<run-receipt.log> to recover exact bytes. Check the receipt log_sha256 before accepting evidence.
artifact_policy.small_evidence: Commit manifests, semantic IR, generation metadata, immutable states/transitions, gate records, replay instructions and the small local recovery bundle.
artifact_policy.supplemental_ci: GitHub Actions uploads are retained for 90 days as additional observations. They are never the sole retained artifact certifying a production proof.
